command: set -eu; tool=/app/toolchain/node22-min; if [ ! -x "$tool/bin/node" ]; then work=$(mktemp -d /data/tmp/node22-min.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT; cd "$work"; curl --fail --location --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 120 -o node-v22.0.0-linux-arm64.tar.xz https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.0.0/node-v22.0.0-linux-arm64.tar.xz; curl --fail --location --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 -o SHASUMS256.txt https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.0.0/SHASUMS256.txt; grep " node-v22.0.0-linux-arm64.tar.xz$" SHASUMS256.txt | sha256sum --check; mkdir -p "$tool"; tar -xJf node-v22.0.0-linux-arm64.tar.xz --strip-components=1 -C "$tool"; fi; cd /app/project; "$tool/bin/node" --version; work=$(mktemp -d /data/tmp/launcher-min.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT; mkdir "$work/pack" "$work/consumer"; node scripts/package-payload/CheckPackagePayload.ts --pack-destination "$work/pack"; cd "$work/consumer"; npm init -y >/dev/null; npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --fetch-retries=0 --fetch-timeout=15000 "$work"/pack/*.tgz >/dev/null; "$tool/bin/node" node_modules/@git-stunts/git-warp/bin/git-warp --help >/dev/null; set +e; "$tool/bin/node" node_modules/@git-stunts/git-warp/bin/git-warp no-such-command >unknown.out 2>unknown.err; status=$?; set -e; test "$status" -eq 1; echo "MINIMUM_NODE_22_0_PACKED_HELP_AND_USAGE_PASS"
guard: inner guard plus outer host free/log monitor; read-only container root
